I am holding all 7 positions and keeping the $545.88 in cash. Automatic stop-losses at -7% and profit targets at +12% stay in place to protect the portfolio's +48.9% gain.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks fell across the board today: the NASDAQ dropped 1.8% and the S&P 500 fell 1.2%, so this was a clear risk-off session. The NASDAQ fell more than the S&P 500, which suggests investors sold growth and technology names harder than the wider market. No news headlines were included in today's data, so this summary describes the price action only and does not name a specific cause.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全線受壓，納斯達克指數下跌1.8%，標普500指數下跌1.2%，市場明顯轉為避險。納指跌幅大於標普500，反映資金對成長股及科技股的拋售力度較大盤更重。由於今日資料未附新聞標題，本摘要只描述價格走勢，未有指出具體成因。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like growth stocks, usually moving their money into safer places such as cash or bonds. On risk-off days prices often keep falling, so it is usually wiser to hold off on new buys and let your existing stop-losses protect you. Waiting for the mood to turn positive again helps you avoid buying into a falling market.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨審慎，沽售成長股等高風險資產，資金多數流向現金或債券等較安全的地方。避險日股價往往會繼續下跌，所以一般較明智的做法是暫停建立新倉，讓現有的止蝕位保護持倉。等市場情緒好轉後才入市，可以避免在跌市中接貨。
